To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the innovation scenarios provide an overview of the search process in innovation-processes, (2) the activities and the elementary information sets provide a detailed view of the search process and (3) the example illustrates the applicabiliy and utility of the activities and elementary information sets.
a user-centered design of an IR system can be realized by the application of innovation scenarios and that these scenarios can be applied to the design of the user interface of an IR system.
the innovation-processes can be improved by means of a dialogue-based information retrieval system which supports the user by means of visualisation of the information retrieved.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a user interface for a patent database.
the development of a user-oriented IR-system which supports a dialogue with the system and offers assistance in the form a connection of dialog.
the development of an advanced IR system for patent databases and digital information libraries which supports the user in a dynamic information dialogue.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
an information dialogue is a promising approach to support the innovation-process in the context of a patent information retrieval.
the innovation scenarios can be used to derive the elementary information set and the elementary activities in the context of an information dialogue.
the information dialogue context is the basis for a successful information retrieval and the support of the innovation process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the user’s information need and the innovation-process should be taken into account in the development of an IR system.

we have defined a model for information dialogues and information visualisation which can support innovation-processes by means of a dialogue and information visualisation in the context of innovation-scenarios.
we have defined and described a set of scenarios for the innovation-process and we have identified and described the activities and conditions of the innovation process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the innovation scenarios are a good basis to design and develop a patent retrieval system.
the information retrieval system should support the user in his or her information need.
we have identified the need to provide a more dynamic information retrieval process.
